name: portal-container
title: Portal Container
summary: Opens dialogs, sheets and drawers inside an element instead of over the whole page.
use_when: Overlays should stay inside a panel, a preview or a device frame
avoid_when: Normal app pages: overlays should cover the page

props.container: The element overlays render into; give it transform or contain: layout

a11y: Focus is still trapped in the open overlay; the rest of the page stays reachable only after it closes
